lines: ({player} holds out the Doggie Bill of Rights. Rook sniffs it. Sniffs it again. Wags.)
(Rook presses a big muddy paw print right in the middle of the page. It's the best signature on there.)
{player}: Is that a yes woof or a no woof?
{player}: I'm going to say that's a 'not really' woof.
(Rook looks up at you. Then at your watch, which is still humming.)

choice.text: Rook, will you come to the lab?
lines: (Rook flattens his ears and lies down flat. He remembers the lab.)

choice.text: There's a ball at the lab, Rook!
lines: (Rook is off like a rocket, towards Dash's house. There had better be a ball.)
(Rook gives you a long look. Somewhere far away, a husky shouts "I'M REX!")
(Rook is in his pod with a ball in his mouth. He wags, just a little.)
{player}: Rook, Rex is running for mayor. What would you want a mayor to do?
{player}: Come on. Every voice counts. Even grumbly ones.
(Rook flops down in a sunny spot and wags, just a little.)
{player}: More naps in the sun. Got it. I'll tell him.
{player}: He's howling at the portal. I think he misses having a tail.
{player}: He's napping in the sun. I'll let him sleep.
{player}: Following them around again? You're a good... um... brother? Dog? Brother-dog.
{player}: He's barking in his sleep. Sweet dreams, Rook.
{player}: Okay, okay! Good morning to you too!

rotate: {player}: Grumpy again? I'd be grumpy too if I woke up as a whole different shape.

lines: {player}: Okay! No belly rubs. Got it.
{player}: He's wagging... his whole body. I think that's a yes.

rotate: {player}: You know, Rex keeps telling everyone he's Rex and you're the dog.
{player}: Yeah. I figured you'd say that.
